C0609.title: Beijing Youth Daily Tests 21 Apps for Account Re-binding Difficulties, Exposing Gaps in Secondary Number User Rights
C0609.summary: In April 2024, Beijing Youth Daily tested account phone-number change processes across 21 mainstream apps and found inconsistent standards. Some apps allowed one phone number to bind multiple accounts, but most allowed only one account per number; if the number was still bound by a previous user, a reassigned-number user might be unable to register or change binding. The report also noted that some apps affected user data during rebinding; for example, Meituan shopping data was retained and rights transferred, but cycling mileage and ride records were cleared.
